sections.Profile:
The "Hit 'N' Run" pinball machine, released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in March 1952, is a single-player, electro-mechanical game designed by Wayne Neyens, with artwork by Roy Parker. The machine features two flippers, four pop bumpers, three passive bumpers, two slingshots, four trap holes, and two rollunder lanes.
